content.short: Sumsub is an all-in-one verification platform that automates KYC, KYB, and AML screening for Web3.
content.description: Sumsub is a leading global verification platform designed to orchestrate the entire user onboarding and compliance process. It provides an all-in-one solution for KYC (Know Your Customer), KYB (Know Your Business), and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) screening, specifically tailored for the needs of the Web3 ecosystem including TON-based projects. Sumsub's platform utilizes advanced AI to automate document verification and liveness checks, helping businesses scale globally while staying compliant with ever-changing international regulations and protecting against fraud.
content.meta: Automate your Web3 compliance with Sumsub. All-in-one KYC and AML solutions on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
